data.title: Leon Lin's design workflow (Cook): the implicit loop
data.body: Set the bar once, then loop build, judge, fix until the stills clear it.

data.title: Setup: agree the bar once
data.body: Steps 1 to 5. Every question is asked one time, with defaults.

data.title: References
data.body: 9-12 images and a short prompt: Dribbble, Inspo or Awwwards MCP, or a real app studied in a browser.

data.title: Intake
data.body: Ask every question once with defaults: references, quality bar, time limit, usage limit.

data.title: Target
data.body: 3 quick mockups on one page. Pick one, check mobile. Cheap to change before the real build.

data.title: Bar
data.body: A number per dimension (aim 99.9%, or 9.2/10 and up). You correct its self-score: it says 90, you say 65.

data.title: Rules
data.body: Slop ban list plus a detector (beige, random fancy fonts, generic cards). Catch many tells at once.

data.title: Loop: build, judge, fix
data.body: Steps 6 to 11. Repeat until the static stills clear the bar, then motion.

data.title: Build static
data.body: Layout, type, color, spacing. No animation yet.

data.title: Judge
data.body: Fresh-context critics, ideally another model (Sol judges Opus). Side by side: reference left, render right.

data.title: Fix weakest
data.body: Specific feedback: exact color or spacing, or a marked-up screenshot. Cannot name it? Ask the agent to describe what it built.

data.title: Motion
data.body: Reference videos studied frame by frame; borrow ideas, never copy one part. Same judge loop.

data.title: Gate
data.body: Stills to you each round. No final render without your OK.

data.title: Ship
data.body: Best scene first, honest numbers, credits.

data.title: State lives in cook/
data.body:
- `brief.md`: the agreed brief
- `references/`: the images and videos
- `rounds/`: screenshots and side-by-sides
- `harness/`: screenshot and grading scripts, judge prompts
- `ROUNDS.md`: the scores, round by round
data.why: A context reset never loses the thread: the next session reads these files and resumes.

data.title: Time and pacing
data.body:
- **Floor ~8h** for demos: done in 2h means something is wrong
- **Hard cap** for small jobs
- Spread the work across your **usage limit**
data.why: Time is what buys the rounds. Rushing skips the judge loop.

data.title: Where we stand
data.body:
**Already match**
- separate critics
- handoff and rounds file
- references as files

**Gaps**
- a number bar and your score correction
- a side-by-side script
- a per-round stills gate
- motion after static
data.why: Close the four gaps and our loop is Cook's loop.

data.title: Relay tie-in
data.body: Annotation and Design Mode put steps 8 and 10 inside Relay: you mark up the page, I fix it.
data.why: Steps 8 (Fix weakest) and 10 (Gate) are the two that happen inside Relay.
